Class FlashcardSetCardController

java.lang.Object
controller.components.FlashcardSetCardController
public class FlashcardSetCardController extends Object
Controller for a flashcard set card component. Displays information about a flashcard set including subject name, card count, and learning progress. Progress display can be toggled, useful for different user roles (teacher vs student).

      public void setProgress(double value)
      Updates the progress bar and progress text label. Displays the progress as both a visual progress bar and percentage text. Also makes the progress elements visible.
      Parameters:
      value - The progress value as a decimal (0.0 to 1.0)

    • setShowProgress

      public void setShowProgress(boolean show)
      Controls the visibility of progress-related UI elements. Useful for hiding progress from teachers who may not need to see student progress on their own sets.
      Parameters:
      show - True to display progress elements, false to hide them
